title: Planner
summary: Support planning, scheduling and progress monitoring on electrical and engineering projects.
intro: Tir Chonaill Careers is an Irish recruitment agency specialising in electrical contracting and engineering. We connect contractors with technical talent for commercial, industrial and infrastructure projects.
description: We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Planner to develop and manage project schedules, monitor progress and help teams deliver works on time and within budget. TEST

sections.heading: Main duties and responsibilities
items: Assist in preparation of schedule data for contracts.
Work with Contracts Managers to determine schedule rates for activities and milestones.
Establish work sequences and activity durations for assigned projects.
Develop and maintain project programmes and schedules.
Attend programme and progress meetings with clients.
Review and analyse supplier schedules.
Monitor project progress and update schedules.
Apply Earned Value, resourcing and progress measurement techniques.
Support preparation of project changes and budget allocations.
Provide ongoing scheduling insights to project teams.
Identify potential delays and propose mitigation strategies.
Ensure alignment between planning, project teams and stakeholders.

sections.heading: Qualifications and experience
items: HNC/HND/BSc in Engineering or equivalent experience.
3+ years’ project planning experience within electrical/engineering contracts.
Ability to establish work sequences and activity durations.
Provide continuous schedule support to project teams.
Excellent written and verbal communication.
Strong time management and organisational skills.
Working knowledge of Primavera P6 preferred; training can be provided.
Able to work independently and in a team.

sections.heading: Desirable skills
items: Planning and scheduling expertise.
Analytical skills and project performance monitoring.
Organisation and ability to manage multiple schedules.
Communication and problem-solving.
Attention to detail, teamwork and Microsoft Office proficiency.

sections.heading: Benefits
items: Additional leave.
Food allowance.
